title: CRISPR/Cas9-based knock-out in human primary T cells
author: Bulent Arman Aksoy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.quxdwxn
materials: RNase Zap everything before you start
Debead and count the activated cells.
Aspirate the media as much as possible.
Electroporation at 1600 V 10 ms 3 pulses (Thermo Fisher Scientific Neon™ Transfection System, MPK5000S)

steps.title: Resuspend crRNA and tracRNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend 2 nmol crRNA in 100 µL RNA storage buffer to obtain a 20 µM solution and resuspend 20 nmol tracRNA in 1 mL RNA storage buffer to obtain a 20 µM solution; aliquot and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare sgRNA mixture
steps.instruction: For each set of four reactions, combine 0.375 µL crRNA and 0.375 µL tracRNA per well (total 1.5 µL crRNA + 1.5 µL tracRNA for four wells) in a PCR tube.

steps.title: Heat‑anneal sgRNA
steps.instruction: Heat the RNA mixture at 95 °C for 5 minutes, then incubate at 37 °C for 25 minutes to allow sgRNA formation.

steps.title: Add Cas9 protein
steps.instruction: Add 0.25 µL Cas9 protein (5 mg/mL) per 200 K cells (equivalent to 1250 ng Cas9 per 200 K cells); for four reactions add a total of 1 µL Cas9 to the PCR tube containing the sgRNA.

steps.title: Incubate RNP complex
steps.instruction: Mix gently and incubate the sgRNA‑Cas9 mixture at 37 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Count and spin T cells
steps.instruction: After debeading and counting, spin the primary human T cells at 200 × g for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in T buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 864 µL T buffer (96 wells × 9 µL per well) to obtain 200 K cells per 9 µL reaction.

steps.title: Combine cells with RNP
steps.instruction: Add 36 µL of the cell suspension to each PCR tube containing the 1 µL RNP mix (for four reactions) and mix well; the total volume per tube will be 10 µL (9 µL cells + 1 µL RNP) suitable for the Neon 10‑tip electroporation.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Electroporate the 10 µL cell‑RNP mixture using the Neon system according to the manufacturer’s settings (not detailed in the source).

steps.title: Seed electroporated cells
steps.instruction: Immediately seed the electroporated cells into a prepared 24‑well plate containing warm T‑cell culture medium.

steps.title: Post‑electroporation analysis
steps.instruction: Three days after electroporation, profile the edited cells by flow cytometry for surface proteins and/or by Western blot for intracellular proteins, depending on the assay of interest.
